## About

A studio ident in three beats. The ring is an ellipse stroke with a Trim Paths item whose End
runs 0 to 100 % while its Offset turns, so the circle draws itself on. The prism mark scales up
with the `pop` curve, and the wordmark is revealed left to right by a feathered Linear Wipe, then
a light sheen (light.sheen) passes across it. Glow and an Outer Glow style give the gold its heat.
